mentions.name: Porchlit
mentions.description: This web app converts RSS, Atom, and blog feeds into audio feeds using Kokoro TTS. It is free and browser-based, with core features working and UI/copy polish still in progress.
mentions.problem: The author wanted to listen to ACOUP and other history blogs as audio while sleeping.
mentions.audience: Built originally for the author's own use, listening to history blogs while sleeping.
mentions.source_excerpt: Turning RSS, atom, blog feeds into audio feeds with kokoro tts. Free, web app only.
mentions.author: aleksiy123
